title: A Gravity for the Terminal Again
author: Freya Vane
blurb: Jonah Iversen, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
